text.text_excerpt: I've eaten a lot of wings over the years from a lot of different places. These guys have really good wings, they let you mix the flavors up too since I like a Hot and Spicy Garlic Parmesan I order them like that and sure enough that's how they come out. Their drink selection is pretty good, although a little pricey, but since I don't eat there that often it's worth getting a gallon of the ghetto punch or my favorite the Pineapple Lemonade. The fries could be better, I think the trip home causes them to soak up the sauce too much so they aren't as crisp as I'd like. Do yourself a favor and check this place out. Don't be afraid of the shatter resistant glass.

My favorite wing place! The wings are perfect but I always get the sauce on the side. The first time I went I didn't know to ask and the stuff was slathered all over and was very messy and overwhelming. Also-you need to check your order before you leave. I have gotten home a couple of times without sauce or with the wrong number of wings. Almost everyone orders a red drink they call Ghetto Punch but I've never ordered it. A word of caution-a few of the clientele may not be trustworthy. The place where you order is behind bulletproof glass and they have one of those box things where the door to the customer and the door to the server cannot be open at the same time. Cajun ranch fries make my world go round. This place is always dependable for good wings and other snacks. I always get the sweet heat wings and Cajun ranch fries so I can't tell you how anything else is. The service is not stellar but isn't terrible either. It's just an order and to place. The ghetto punch tastes like diabetes in a cup to me but I'm not big on things with a high level of sweetness in general. They have lots of wing flavors to try along with the fries (of course) and onion rings, crawfish balls, etc.
